csv_project_name: As-needed Construction Insp Engineering & Administrative Scv
csv_scope_of_work: The County intends to establish an on-call contract with a Consultant to provide engineering services on an as-needed basis. The County reserves the right to make one or more awards to the responsible Consultant(s) whose proposals represent the best value to the County. The assignment of work shall be at the sole discretion of the County. All Consultants shall waive any claim of any Consultants against the County for extra compensation or damages arising out of assignment of work by the County. The site-specific requirements of each construction site will vary. Generally, the duties involve visual observation and on-site measurements at the construction of utilities, roads, buildings, bridges, fields, open space, pump stations, and structures. The work requires verbal and written communication with contractors, construction representatives, and Howard County constituents and staff
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Inspection Services, Structural Engineering
